name: Breaking Point 2
desc:
A remaster of the classic Breaking Point, with hundreds of new cosmetic skins to collect and features! The game will receive an update soon.

- 🔪 12 unique game modes including brand new modes to play, like Musical Chairs and Knife Tag
- Frequent seasonal events, missions, updates, and more 
- Improved mechanics, economy, and patches 
- Voice chat with friends!
